description: This file manages approval workflows for test outputs, including reading existing approvals/rejections, prompting user or automated approval, and saving new approval status files.

methods.name: getExistingOutputs
methods.description: Retrieves existing approved or rejected output files for a given test category and name.

methods.name: getCategoryPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to the category directory within approvals.

methods.name: getNextFileNumber
methods.description: Calculates the next sequential file number for approval/rejection files.

methods.name: findMatchingFile
methods.description: Finds a file with matching content among approved or rejected files.

methods.name: askUserApproval
methods.description: Prompts the user to approve or reject the output via command line.

methods.name: checkApproval
methods.description: Main function to check if a test output is approved, rejected, or needs new approval, and records the decision.
